Haa-Meem .
qasam hai iss wazeh kitab ki ,
hum ney issay arbi zaban ka Quran banaya hai , takay tum samjho
aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh humaray paas loah-e-mehfooz mein baray oonchay darjay ki hikmat say bhari hoi kitab hai .
bhala kiya hum mun morr ker iss naseehat namay ko tum say iss bana per hata len kay tum hadd say guzray huye log ho-?
aur kitney hi nabi hum ney pichlay logon  mein bhi bhejay hain ,
aur unn logon  kay paas koi nabi aisa nahi aaya jiss ka woh mazaq naa uratay hon .
phir jo log inn ( makkah walon ) say kahen ziyada zor aawar thay , hum ney unhen halak kerdiya , aur unn pichlay logon  ka haal peechay guzar chuka hai .

aur agar tum inn ( mushrikon ) say poocho kay saray aasman aur zameen kiss ney peda kiye hain , to woh zaroor yehi kahen gay kay :  unhen uss zaat ney peda kiya hai jo iqtidar ki bhi malik hai , ilm ki bhi malik .
yeh woh zaat hai jiss ney tumharay liye zameen ko bichona banaya , aur uss mein tumharay liye raastay banaye , takay tum manzil tak phonch sako ,
aur jiss ney aasman say aik khaas andazay say paani utaara , phir hum ney uss kay zariye aik murda ilaqay ko naee zindagi dey di issi tarah tumhen ( qabron say ) nikal ker naee zindagi di jaye gi
aur jiss ney her tarah kay jooray peda kiye , aur tumharay liye woh kashtiyan aur chopaye banaye jinn per tum sawari kertay ho ,

takay tum unn ki pusht per charrho , phir jab unn per charh ker beth jao to apney perwerdigar ki naimat ko yaad kero , aur yeh kaho kay :  pak hai woh zaat jiss ney iss sawari ko humaray bus mein dey diya , werna hum mein yeh taqat nahi thi kay iss ko qaboo mein laasaktay .
aur beyshak hum apney perwerdigar ki taraf loat ker janey walay hain .
aur inn ( mushrik ) logon  ney yeh baat banai hai kay Allah ka khud uss kay bandon mein say koi juzz hai .   haqeeqat yeh hai kay insan khullam khula nashukra hai .
bhala kiya Allah ney apni makhlooq mein say apney liye to betiyan pasand ki hain , aur tumhen beton kay liye muntakhib kiya hai-?

halankay unn mein say kissi ko jab uss ( beti ) ki ( wiladat ) ki khushkhabri di jati hai jo uss ney khudaye rehman ki taraf mansoob ker rakhi hai to uss ka chehra siyah parr-jata hai , aur woh dil hi dil mein ghutta rehta hai .
aur kiya ( Allah ney aesi aulad pasand ki hai ) jo zewaron mein paali posi jati hai , aur jo behas mubahisay mein apni baat khul ker bhi nahi keh sakti-?

iss kay ilawa unhon ney farishton ko jo khudaye rehman kay banday hain , moannis bana diya hai . kiya yeh log unn ki takhleeq kay waqt mojood thay-? inn ka yeh dawa likh liya jaye ga , aur inn say baaz purs hogi .

aur yeh kehtay hain kay :  agar khudaye rehman chahta to hum inn ( farishton ) ki ibadat naa kertay .  inn ko iss baat ki haqeeqat ka zara bhi ilm nahi hai , aur inn ka kaam iss kay siwa kuch nahi kay andazon kay teer chalatay hain .
bhala kiya hum ney unhen iss say pehlay koi kitab di thi jissay yeh thamay bethay hain-?
nahi , balkay inn ka kehna yeh hai kay hum ney apney baap dadon ko aik tareeqay per paya hai , aur hum unhi kay naqsh-e-qadam kay mutabiq theek theek raastay per jarahey hain .

aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tum say pehlay jab bhi kissi basti mein koi khabrdar kernay wala ( payghumber ) bheja to wahan kay dolat mand logon  ney yehi kaha kay :  hum ney apney baap dadon ko aik tareeqay per paya hai , aur hum unhi kay naqsh-e-qadam kay peechay chal rahey hain .

payghumber ney kaha kay :  tum ney apney baap dadon ko jiss tareeqay per paya hai , agar mein tumharay paas uss say ziyada hidayat ki baat ley ker aaya hun to kiya phir bhi ( tum apney tareeqay per chalay jao gay-? )  unhon ney jawab diya kay :  tum jo paygham dey ker bhejay gaye ho hum to uss ko manney walay nahi hain .
nateeja yeh huwa kay hum ney unn say intiqam liya , abb dekh lo kay jhutlaney walon ka anjam kaisa huwa-?
aur woh waqt yaad kero jab Ibrahim ney apney baap aur apni qoam say kaha tha kay :  mein unn cheezon say beyzar hun jinn ki tum ibadat kertay ho ,
siwaye uss zaat kay jiss ney mujhay peda kiya hai , chunacheh wohi meri rehnumai kerta hai .
aur Ibrahim ney iss ( aqeeday ) ko aesi baat bana diya jo unn ki aulad mein baqi rahi , takay log ( shirk say ) baaz ayen .

. ( phir bhi boht say log baaz naa aaye ) uss kay bawajood mein ney unn ko aur unn kay baap dadon ko zindagi kay faeeday diye , yahan tak kay unn kay paas haq aur saaf saaf hidayat denay wala payghumber aagaya .
aur jab woh haq unn kay paas aaya to woh kehney lagay kay :  yeh to jadoo hai , aur hum iss ka inkar kertay hain .
aur kehney lagay kay :  yeh Quran do bastiyon mein say kissi baray aadmi per kiyon nazil nahi kiya gaya-?

bhala kiya yeh log hain jo tumharay perwerdigar ki rehmat taqseem keren gay-?   dunyawi zindagi mein inn ki rozi kay zaraye bhi hum ney hi inn kay darmiyan taqseem ker rakhay hain , aur hum ney hi inn mein say aik ko doosray per darjaat mein foqiyat di hai , takay woh aik doosray say kaam ley saken . aur tumharay perwerdigar ki rehmat to uss ( dolat ) say kahen behtar cheez hai jo yeh jama ker rahey hain .

aur agar yeh andesha naa hota kay tamam insan aik hi tareeqay kay ( yani kafir ) hojayen gay to jo log khudaye rehman kay munkir hain , hum unn kay liye unn kay gharon ki chatten bhi chaandi ki bana detay , aur woh serhiyan bhi jinn per woh charrhtay hain ,
aur unn kay gharon kay darwazay bhi , aur woh takht bhi jinn per woh takiya laga ker bethtay hain .
balkay unhen sona bana detay . aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh sabb kuch bhi nahi , sirf dunyawi zindagi ka saman hai .   aur aakhirat tumharay perwerdigar kay nazdeek perhezgaron kay liye hai .
aur jo shaks khudaye rehman kay ziker say andha ban jaye , hum uss per aik shetan musallat ker-detay hain jo uss ka sathi ban jata hai .
aesay shayateen unn ko raastay say roktay rehtay hain , aur woh samajhtay hain kay hum theek raastay per hain .
yahan tak kay jab aisa shaks humaray paas aaye ga to ( apney shetan sathi say ) kahey ga kay :  kaash ! meray aur teray darmiyan mashriq o maghrib ka fasla hota , kiyonkay tu boht bura sathi tha .
aur aaj jab tum zulm ker-chukay ho to tumhen yeh baat hergiz koi faeeda nahi phonchaye gi kay tum azab mein aik doosray kay shareek ho .
to phir ( aey payghumber ! ) kiya tum behron ko sunao gay , ya andhon ko aur unn logon  ko raastay per lao gay jo khuli gumrahi mein parray huye hain-?
abb to yehi hoga kay agar hum tumhen duniya say uthalen , tab bhi hum inn say badla lenay walay hain ,
ya agar tumhen bhi woh ( azab ) dikha den jiss ka hum ney inn say wada kiya hai , tab bhi hamen inn per her tarah ki qudrat hasil hai .
lehaza tum per jo wahi nazil ki gaee hai , ussay mazbooti say thamay rakho , yaqeenan tum seedhay raastay per ho .
aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh wahi tumharay liye aur tumhari qoam kay liye aik naik naami ka zariya hai , aur tum sabb say poocha jaye ga ( kay tum ney iss ka kiya haq ada kiya-? )
aur tum say pehlay hum ney apney jo payghumber bhejay hain , unn say pooch lo   kay kiya hum ney khudaye rehman kay siwa koi aur mabood bhi muqarrar kiye thay jinn ki ibadat ki jaye-?
aur hum ney musa ko apni nishaniyan dey ker firon aur uss kay sardaron kay paas bheja tha , chunacheh musa ney kaha kay :  mein Rabb-ul-Aalameen ka bheja huwa payghumber hun .
phir jab unhon ney humari nishaniyan unn kay samney paish ken to woh unn ka mazaq uraney lagay .
aur hum unhen jo nishani bhi dikhatay , woh pehli nishani say barh charh ker hoti thi , aur hum ney unhen azab mein bhi pakra , takay woh baaz aajayen .

aur woh yeh kehney lagay kay :  aey jadoogar ! tum say tumharay perwerdigar ney jo ehad ker rakha hai , uss ka wasta dey ker uss say humaray liye dua kero , hum yaqeenan raah-e-raast per aajayen gay .
phir jab hum unn say azab ko door ker-detay to pal bhar mein woh apna wada torr daaltay thay .

aur firon ney apni qoam kay darmiyan pukar ker kaha kay :  aey meri qoam ! kiya misir ki saltanat meray qabazay mein nahi hai-? aur ( dekho ) yeh darya meray neechay beh rahey hain . kiya tumhen dikhai nahi deta-?
ya phir maano kay mein iss shaks say kahen behtar hun jo bara haqeer qisam ka hai , aur apni baat khul ker kehna bhi iss kay liye mushkil hai .
bhala ( agar yeh payghumber hai to ) iss per soney kay kanggan kiyon nahi daalay gaye-? ya phir iss kay sath farishtay paray baandhay huye kiyon naa aaye-?
iss tarah uss ney apni qoam ko beywaqoof banaya , aur unhon ney uss ka kehna maan liya . haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh sabb gunehgaar log thay .
chunacheh jab unhon ney hamen naraz kerdiya to hum ney unn say intiqam liya , aur unn sabb ko gharq kerdiya .
aur hum ney unhen aik gaee guzri qoam aur baad walon kay liye ibrat ka namoona banadiya .
aur jab ( essa ) ibn-e-maryam ki misal di gaee to tumhari qoam kay log yakayak shor machaney lagay .
aur kehney lagay kay :  humaray mabood behtar hain ya woh-?  unhon ney tumharay samney yeh misal mehaz katt hujjati kay liye di hai , balkay yeh log hain hi jhagrraloo .
woh ( yani essa aleh-assalam ) to bus humaray aik banday thay jinn per hum ney inaam kiya tha , aur bani Israel kay liye unn ko aik namoona banaya tha .
aur agar hum chahen to tum say farishtay peda kerden jo zameen mein aik doosray kay janasheen ban ker raha keren .
aur yaqeen rakho kay woh ( yani essa aleh-assalam ) qayamat ki aik nishani hain ,   iss liye tum uss mein shak naa kero , aur meri baat maano . yehi seedha raasta hai .
aur aisa hergiz naa honey paye kay shetan tumhen iss raastay say rok dey . yaqeen jano woh tumhara khula dushman hai .

aur jab essa khuli hoi nishaniyan ley ker aaye thay to unhon ney ( logon  say ) kaha tha kay :  mein tumharay paas danai ki baat ley ker aaya hun , aur iss liye laya hun kay tumharay samney kuch woh cheezen wazeh kerdun jinn mein tum ikhtilaf kertay ho . lehaza tum Allah say daro , aur meri baat maan lo .
yaqeenan Allah hi mera bhi rab hai , aur tumhara bhi rab hai , iss liye uss ki ibadat kero . yehi seedha raasta hai .
phir bhi unn mein say kaee girohon ney ikhtilaf peda kiya , chunacheh unn zalimon kay liye aik dardnak din kay azab ki wajeh say bari kharabi hogi .
yeh log bus iss baat ka intizar ker rahey hain kay qayamat inn kay samney achanak aa-khari ho , aur enhen khabar bhi naa ho .
uss din tamam dost aik doosray kay dushman hon gay , siwaye muttaqi logon  kay ,
. ( jinn say kaha jaye ga kay : )  aey meray bando ! aaj tum per naa koi khof taari hoga , aur naa tum ghumgeen hogay .
aey meray woh bando jo humari aayaton per emaan laye thay , aur farmanbardaar rahey thay !
tum bhi aur tumhari biwiyan bhi , khushi say chamaktay chehron kay sath jannat mein dakhil hojao .

unn kay aagay soney kay piyalay aur glass gardish mein laye jayen gay . aur uss jannat mein her woh cheez hogi jiss ki dilon ko khuwaish hogi , aur jiss say aankhon ko lazzat hasil hogi . ( unn say kaha jaye ga kay : )  iss jannat mein tum hamesha raho gay .
aur yeh woh jannat hai jiss ka tumhen apney aemal kay badlay waris bana diya gaya hai .
iss mein tumharay liye khoob ifraat kay sath meway hain jinn mein say tum khao gay .
albatta jo log mujrim thay , woh dozakh kay azab mein hamesha rahen gay .
woh azab unn kay liye halka nahi parrney diya jaye ga , aur woh uss mein mayyus parray hon gay .
aur hum ney unn per koi zulm nahi kiya , lekin woh khud hi zalim log thay .
aur woh ( dozakh kay farishtay say ) pukar ker kahen gay kay :  aey malik ! tumhara perwerdigar humara kaam hi tamam kerday .    woh kahey ga kay :  tumhen issi haal mein rehna hai .
aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum tumharay paas haq baat ley ker aaye thay , lekin tum mein say aksar log haq baat hi ko bura samajhtay hain .
haan kiya inn logon  ney kuch kernay ka faisla kerliya hai ? acha to hum bhi kuch kernay ka faisla kernay walay hain .

kiya unhon ney yeh samajh rakha hai kay hum inn ki khufiya baaten aur inn ki sargoshiyan nahi suntay-? kaisay nahi suntay-? neez humaray farishtay inn kay paas hain , woh sabb kuch likhtay rehtay hain .
. ( aey payghumber ! ) keh do kay :  agar khudaye rehman ki koi aulad hoti to sabb say pehla ibadat kernay wala mein hota .
woh jo aasmano aur zameen ka bhi malik hai , arsh ka bhi malik , woh unn sari baaton say pak hai jo yeh banaya kertay hain .

lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) unhen apney haal per chorr do kay yeh unn baaton mein doobay rahen , aur hansi khel kertay rahen , yahan tak kay woh apney uss din say ja-milen jiss ka unn say wada kiya jaraha hai .
wohi ( Allah ) hai jo aasman mein bhi mabood hai , aur zameen mein bhi mabood . aur wohi hai jo hikmat ka bhi malik hai , ilm ka bhi malik .

aur bari shaan hai uss ki jiss kay qabazay mein aasmano aur zameen aur unn kay darmiyan tamam cheezon ki saltanat hai , aur ussi kay paas qayamat ka ilm hai , aur ussi kay paas tum sabb ko wapis ley jaya jaye ga .
aur yeh log ussay chorr ker jinn maboodon ko pukartay hain , unhen koi sifarish kernay ka ikhtiyar nahi hoga , haan albatta jinn logon  ney haq baat ki gawahi di ho , aur unhen uss ka ilm bhi ho .
aur agar tum unn logon  say poocho kay unn ko kiss ney peda kiya hai to woh zaroor yehi kahen gay kay Allah ney . iss kay bawajood koi unhen kahan say ondha chala deta hai-?
aur Allah ko payghumber ki iss baat ka bhi ilm hai kay :  ya rab ! yeh aesay log hain jo emaan nahi latay .
lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum inn ki perwa naa kero , aur keh do :  salam !    kiyonkay unqareeb enhen khud sabb pata chal jaye ga .
